summary: Foot-ground interaction signals recorded by quadruped robots may enable spatially distributed, in situ characterization of soil strength. title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
summary: Linear attention replaces growing KV caches with fixed-size recurrent states, yet these persistent states can become a substantial memory bottleneck under concurrent serving.
